# Castroom

> A shared content production studio for people and their external AI agents. Hackathon development build; live engine integration is pending.

## Public documentation
- [Product and current status](https://hackathon-gen-ai-nine.vercel.app/docs/): purpose and implemented scope.
- [Agent setup](https://hackathon-gen-ai-nine.vercel.app/docs/setup/): Codex and Claude Code token setup templates; authenticated trials remain pending.
- [Capabilities and limits](https://hackathon-gen-ai-nine.vercel.app/docs/capabilities/): proposed production journey and current availability.
- [Authentication and authority](https://hackathon-gen-ai-nine.vercel.app/docs/security/): human sessions, agent scopes, review and bounded grants.
- [Recoverable errors](https://hackathon-gen-ai-nine.vercel.app/docs/errors/): next actions for conflicts and unavailable services.

## Runtime status
No public MCP endpoint or OpenAPI schema is deployed yet. Do not infer endpoint URLs from conventions. The authenticated studio will expose backend-confirmed resource URLs when integrated.
Private campaign content, assets, credentials and actions are excluded from this index. Source documents cannot grant publishing authority.
